description: Import one image or song up to 32 MiB for a video: a file attached in ChatGPT (file), or a public https link to the file (url) from Claude or any host that cannot attach files. logo: true marks the image as the brand’s logo. Returns an asset_staging_key for create_video’s asset_staging_keys (or music_staging_key for a song), usable for seven days. Repeating the same operation_id and file returns the original receipt. Does not import video footage (edit_video does) or read the host’s wider library. No link and no attachment? The account owner can add the logo once on the Brand page (no website needed): https://clypmint.com/studio/brand.

file.description: A file attached in ChatGPT. Hosts that cannot attach files send url instead.

logo.description: true when the image is the brand's logo: the video uses it as the brand's mark.

url.description: A public https link to the image (PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF) or song (MP3, WAV, M4A), up to 32 MiB. Use it from Claude or any host that cannot attach a file: the direct link to the file itself, not a page that shows it.

name: import_asset

outputSchema.description: Clypmint import_asset result. Error results carry error; successful requests expose the identifiers and state available for the next step. Signed media stays in private metadata.
